browser: Installed stable Google Chrome 156 (headless, temporary profile) driven over the DevTools protocol; trusted keyboard, mouse and touch events only; visible DOM text and screenshots read; no game state read or injected; no Playwright.

observed: Readable layout, but flat water, flat banks and a box raft fell short of the roster art; the opening prompt named no key.
Paddler with wake, moving ripples, rock foam, bank shallows, reeds and cliffs; prompts name keys. Presentation accepted.
A prompt-text-only driver won (2400, hull intact) but the steering prompt flickered every 0.3-0.5 s; sent as a finding with the reviewer's slow-player tuning finding.
Thin pale shield arc hard to see; plain checkerboard floor; unexplained faint circle.
Bold glowing segmented shield, stone flagstones, starry ring wall with telescope, plinth turrets. Presentation accepted.
Strata, caves and key-naming prompts read well; lives icons clipped at the right edge; no visible lift; helmet lamps and collapse dust missing; sector banner overlapped the top tunnels.
Hearts inside the frame, labelled lift cage, helmet-lamp halos, timber beams. Presentation accepted.

Full English campaign won for 2400 with hull 3/3 by a driver that reads only the page status text every 0.15 s and presses the key it names (Press Up/Down, Right + Space, Press X / Docking). All three rivers docked after a real stop.
Prompts now hold about 0.6 s; 12 of 105 changes were shorter than 0.5 s, mostly section-start Up/Down alternation and dock events.
Win screen ignored input; R restarted at 0 with best 2400. Ramming the banks with strokes cost hull 3 to 0 and reached 'The raft broke apart'; the loss screen ignored input.

Chinese 390x844 portrait: no horizontal overflow; six touch controls; holding Down plus a stroke moved the raft into the bank and the prompt asked to press Up. 844x390 landscape fullscreen places direction and stroke/brake controls in side columns.
limitations: Emulated touch and phone layouts; no physical device or audio check.
Players with 0.4-0.8 s reactions win about 70-80% of runs (reviewer); 0.4-0.6 s wins every run.

observed: On c2edc3d2 (identical mechanics), a visual-only driver that reads the page status text and the canvas pixels — facing the nearest cyan or orange threat with Space held, stepping perpendicular out of red lanes, leaving the slam circle and bashing nearby crawlers — won all three waves and the Guardian for 5725. Earlier, cruder driver runs reached the loss screen ('The sentinel fell…').
The slam telegraph is purple while the text said red; the final build says purple everywhere (EN/ZH).

Win screen ignored input. On the final build, Chinese 390x844 portrait shows six touch controls and multi-touch Left+Up+Shield raised the arc facing up-left; 844x390 landscape fullscreen places movement and shield/bash in side columns.
limitations: The winning visual run ended at 1 HP; the driver is cruder than a human. Emulated touch and phone layouts only.

observed: Full English campaign on 37a3d611 (rules, colliders and art identical to the final build): all three sectors cleared for 9100 with all seven miners and no lives lost, following the visible prompts (dig, place a beam when asked, wake with X, stand on the lift). Air tanks and surface refills kept oxygen up; one route correction returned to the surface to refill.

Every collapse was preceded by the 'Cracks! X: brace here' countdown; deliberately unbraced tunnels collapsed after the warning, each costing a life and hauling the player up; the third ended the run. Win and loss screens ignored input; R restarted with the best score kept.

Final build e5b2287d (prompt-only changes): sector 1 replayed in Chinese; an unbraced run showed the stay-clear warning then 'Cracks! press X to brace (1 s)', bracing saved it and the miner was rescued without losing a life; dig prompts held steadily.
Chinese 390x844 portrait: six touch controls; touch Down+Dig cut a shaft. 844x390 landscape fullscreen places movement and dig/beam controls in side columns.

Final build ceb0bf44 (status-text and message changes only since e5b2287d): sector 1 west miner rescued; the page status line announced 'Beams restocked · Stay on the lift: miners coming' then 'Miner rescued! +1000 · Face earth, press Space to dig' and fell back to the prompt. Earlier f5de127d check confirmed the 'Cracks! X: brace here (3s…1s)' countdown precedes a cave-in.
limitations: Prompts say what to press but not which way to dig; players read the static map for direction.
The tester's walk helper overshot by a tile several times; corrections were made through normal play.
Emulated touch and phone layouts only.
